errors.message: characteristics[enrichment process] appears after material type — local validator enforces strict group order (official validator only checks relative to assay name)

_note: The official sdrf-pipelines validator does not flag the column order issue here because it only checks positioning relative to 'assay name'. The local validator implements the stricter group-based order (source name → characteristics → material type → ... → assay name), which is the correct SDRF specification order.
